blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: Which SkyTrain station serves Connaught Heights?
faq.a: 22nd Street Station on the Expo Line, which the OCP identifies as a Frequent Transit Development Area; TransLink routes from the station include the 100, 101, 104 and 128.

faq.q: What sold in Connaught Heights in September 2026?
faq.a: Nothing in the SnapStats extraction — the sub-area listed 15 detached homes with 0 solds and had no condos & townhomes listings; at the New Westminster community level the detached median sale price was $1,365,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $560,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve a Connaught Heights address?
faq.a: For the sample address 2201 London Street, the SD40 locator result is Connaught Heights Elementary, Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary, with Montessori offered at Connaught Heights Elementary itself; catchments are address-based.

faq.q: When were New Westminster property taxes due in 2026?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 3, 2026 and a second 5% penalty on any unpaid balance on September 3, 2026.
